steps.name: Fetch full history without tags
steps.run:
gh auth setup-git
git fetch --no-tags --filter=blob:none --unshallow origin

steps.name: Determine merge base
steps.run:
if [[ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" == "pull_request" ]]; then
  # The first parent contains any preceding layers in a stacked pull request.
  sha="$(git rev-parse "${GITHUB_SHA}^1")"
else
  sha="$(git merge-base HEAD "origin/${BASE_REF}")"
fi
echo "sha=${sha}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Run ShellCheck
steps.run:
files=()
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  files+=("${file}")
done < <(git ls-files -z '*.sh')
if ((${#files[@]} == 0)); then
  exit 0
fi
go run github.com/wasilibs/go-shellcheck/cmd/shellcheck@v0.11.1 "${files[@]}"

cat ecosystem-result-check-stable > "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "### Linter (stable)"  > ecosystem-result
cat ecosystem-result-check-stable >> ecosystem-result
echo "" >> ecosystem-result

steps.name: Collect HTML reports
steps.run:
python - <<'PYTHON'
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

files = {
    name: metadata for name, metadata in json.loads(os.environ["HTML_FILES"]).items()
    if (Path("ecosystem-html") / name).is_file()
}
with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a") as output:
    output.write(f"html-files={json.dumps(files)}\n")
PYTHON

steps.name: Fail on ecosystem errors

  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Fuzz
steps.run:
echo "new commit"
git rev-list --format=%s --max-count=1 "$GITHUB_SHA"
cargo build --profile=profiling --bin=ty
mv target/profiling/ty ty-new

git checkout -b old_commit "$MERGE_BASE"
echo "old commit (merge base)"
git rev-list --format=%s --max-count=1 old_commit
cargo build --profile=profiling --bin=ty
mv target/profiling/ty ty-old

git checkout --detach "$GITHUB_SHA"

(
  uv run \
  --python="${PYTHON_VERSION}" \
  --project=./python/py-fuzzer \
  --locked \
  fuzz \
  --test-executable=ty-new \
  --baseline-executable=ty-old \
  --only-new-bugs \
  --output-format=github \
  --save-failures=ty-fuzz-failures \
  ${FUZZ_CORPUS:+--corpus-dir="$FUZZ_CORPUS"} \
  --budget-minutes="${FUZZ_JOB_TIMEOUT_MINUTES}" \
  --job-started-at="${FUZZ_JOB_STARTED_AT}" \
  --bin=ty \
  "$FUZZ_CORPUS_SEEDS"
)

steps.name: Upload failing inputs and ty binaries
Prepare fuzz status messages
steps.run:
mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/ty-fuzz-status"
cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/ty-fuzz-status"
if [[ "$FUZZ_OUTCOME" == "success" ]]; then
  echo 'The fuzzer found no new ty panics or timeouts.' > status.md
else
  echo '⚠️ Panic or timeout detected. Minimization in progress…' > status.md
  printf 'Minimization report unavailable. [Download the failing inputs](%s).\n' "$FAILURES_URL" > ty-fuzz-report.md
fi

Value.expr: needs.fuzz-ty.result == 'success' && 'ty fuzzing passed ✅' || '❌ ty fuzz failures'

steps.name: Minimize failing inputs
steps.run:
cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/ty-fuzz"
chmod +x ty-new ty-old
uv run --python="$PYTHON_VERSION" --project="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/python/py-fuzzer" --locked fuzz \
  --bin=ty --test-executable=ty-new --baseline-executable=ty-old --only-new-bugs \
  --minimize-failures=ty-fuzz-failures \
  --budget-minutes="$FUZZ_JOB_TIMEOUT_MINUTES" --job-started-at="$FUZZ_JOB_STARTED_AT" \
  --write-github-comment="$RUNNER_TEMP/ty-fuzz-report.md"

steps.name: Run prek
steps.run:
echo '```console' > "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
# Enable color output for prek and remove it for the summary
# Use --hook-stage=manual to enable slower hooks that are skipped by default
SKIP=rustfmt uv run --only-dev --locked prek run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color always --hook-stage manual | \
  tee >(sed -E 's/\x1B\[([0-9]{1,2}(;[0-9]{1,2})*)?[mGK]//g' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY") >&1
exit_code="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo '```' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
exit "$exit_code"

steps.name: Build benchmarks
steps.run: uv run --only-dev cargo codspeed build -m simulation -m memory --features "codspeed,ruff_instrumented" --profile profiling --no-default-features -p ruff_benchmark --bench formatter --bench lexer --bench linter --bench parser

steps.name: Configure apt mirror fallback
steps.run:
# Let CodSpeed's dependency installation move past unhealthy mirrors quickly.
cat /etc/apt/apt-mirrors.txt
printf '%s\n' \
  'Acquire::Retries "0";' \
  'Acquire::http::Timeout "10";' \
  'Acquire::https::Timeout "10";' \
  | sudo tee /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/80-retries > /dev/null

steps.name: Build benchmarks
steps.run: uv run --only-dev cargo codspeed build -m simulation -m memory --features "codspeed,module_resolution,ty_instrumented" --profile profiling --no-default-features -p ruff_benchmark --bench module_resolution --bench ty --bench ty_constraint_set

steps.name: Build benchmarks

steps.name: Check required jobs passed
steps.run:
failing=$(echo "$NEEDS_JSON" | jaq -r 'to_entries[] | select(.value.result != "success" and (.value.result != "skipped" or .key == "cargo-cooldowns")) | "\(.key): \(.value.result)"')
if [ -n "$failing" ]; then
  echo "$failing"
  exit 1
fi
